# Three.js vendor files

Version `0.180.0` is vendored from the official `three` npm package so the local research dashboard can render its geography without a runtime CDN or map service.

- `three.module.min.js`: package `build/three.module.min.js`
- `three.core.min.js`: package `build/three.core.min.js` (required by the module build)
- `OrbitControls.js`: package `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `LICENSE.txt`: upstream MIT license
